This document is a technical README/engineering log for **Project Maya**, an open-source inference engine for large MoE models (GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, MiniMax-M3.1-Flash) with experimental AMD HIP support. Key technical points:

## Models & Quantization
